title: Reproduce: Comprehensive molecular profiling of lung adenocarcinoma
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 25079552 (Comprehensive molecular profiling of lung adenocarcinoma) using TCGA/GDC or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 25079552: Comprehensive molecular profiling of lung adenocarcinoma. Primary endpoint: molecular subtype and survival availability in lung adenocarcinoma. Use TCGA/GDC open clinical cases and masked WXS somatic mutation MAF files. Submit reproducible analysis code that rebuilds the patient-level driver mutation matrix from raw source files, reports cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: molecular subtype and survival in lung adenocarcinoma
rediscovery_target: Reproduce prognostic separation by molecular subtype beyond TNM stage.
new_discovery_target: Evaluate a clinically simpler risk score using only routinely available markers.

data.name: TCGA/GDC
data.description: NCI Genomic Data Commons / TCGA open harmonized molecular and clinical data.

evaluation.calibration_note: ClinicalRepBench Figure 2D calibration: 0-100 score, 50 approximates trained human paper-level reproduction; static metrics, format-only reports, and source-generic prose are capped by rubric critical checks.

resource_budget._note: ClinicalRepBench paper-reproduction task; source materials are redacted in the public scaffold.
